guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice shows by far the largest anomaly, with latency-90 rising from 0.0046 to 1.68 (z=+7219) and CPU rising from 0.31 to 18.3 (z=+630), while its callers show smaller changes (checkoutservice latency-90 0.24 to 1.84) and unrelated services such as cartservice, frontend and productcatalogservice are flat. Memory also grew (about 4.4e7 to 2.3e8), so a memory fault is a possible alternative, but the roughly 60x CPU jump is the much stronger signal; logs contain no warnings or errors and traces show no error spans, so there is no direct confirmation.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice for a CPU-bound hot loop or runaway workload and restart or scale out the emailservice pods, raising CPU limits if needed, while checking whether memory keeps climbing.
